svg.title: St Petersburg: deaths over 6 years
svg.desc: Six-year mortality: placebo 81.8% (n=22), thymalin 41.7% (24), epithalamin 45.8% (24), both for 2 years 33.3% (24), both yearly for 6 years 20.0% (20, separate group including men).
